summary: Experienced Human Resources professional with a background in mobilizing employees for international assignments and supporting HR operations. Skilled in policy development, employee relations, benefits administration, and cross-cultural HR support.

experience.title: HR Generalist
experience.employer: a multinational oil and gas company
bullets: Mobilized high-volume employees overseas on short/long-term assignments in accompanied/unaccompanied status.
Served as primary point of contact for expatriate and inpatriate assignments from start to finish.
Directed and implemented HR policies and procedures and provided guidance to field HR managers.
Created assignment offers including compensation packages, uplifts, base pay, per diem, additional payments, and benefits.
Managed employee relations, policy development, training, recruitment, payroll, and benefits administration.
Attended corporate planning meetings and assisted in rewriting international assignment policies and procedures.
Conducted interviews and trained new employees.
Administered the Goods and Services review program twice a year.
Evaluated new hire documents and employee evaluations and provided extensive training to staff.
Prepared and presented training seminars to HR professionals.
Assisted employees with benefits, payroll, HR systems, and administrative issues.
Managed regions including Germany, Kuwait, Brazil, Australia, Italy, Mexico, China, Zambia, and Angola.

experience.title: HR Associate Mobilization Coordinator
experience.employer: a global engineering and construction firm
bullets: Handled unemployment and workers' compensation claims, maintained personnel files, and updated the affirmative action plan.
Responded with sensitivity and in a timely manner to employee problems and concerns.
Presented company policies, procedures, philosophy, and benefits to new employees.
Attended corporate planning meetings and assisted in writing policies and procedures.
Arranged medical appointments, assignment paperwork, travel, hotel, car rental, temporary housing, and tax briefings.
Prepared and processed personnel transfer paperwork.
Prepared and distributed correspondence to internal and external candidates.
Applied for entry and work visas.
Managed regions including Nigeria, Chad, Indonesia, Algeria, Canada, and Qatar.

experience.title: Administrative Specialist / Tax Assistant
bullets: Managed the Tax Equalization Program for expatriates and inpatriates.
Collected check payments, verified amounts, and sent to payroll for endorsement.
Assisted expatriates with completing tax forms and answered questions.
Completed check requests for reimbursement of P&I on employees and IRS notices.
Initiated move notices.
Administered the Certificate of Coverage program for expatriates on assignment.
Ordered office materials and supplies from various vendors.
Composed and typed collection letters and other correspondence via email or certified mail.
Backed up timesheet keeper and Web pan initiator.
Coded and processed invoices and overhead financial numbers.

experience.title: Administrative Associate
bullets: Provided administrative or secretarial support to a department.
Completed defined tasks in accordance with standard procedures.
Supported general business operations by providing administrative support activities.
Compiled, copied, sorted, and filed records of office activities, business transactions, and other activities.
Collected and distributed department and employee mail.
Set up pouch mail for new projects.
Took passport and visa photos.
Notified payroll, HR, and A&F of employees' new assignments or completions.
Structured and maintained a clean and organized office area.

experience.title: HR Management VP
bullets: Served as HR Management VP for the SHRM student chapter.
Supported chapter activities related to HR management.

experience.title: Member
bullets: Member of SHRM Houston from 2009 to 2017.
Member of HR Houston from 2009 to 2018.
Member of Houston International HR Roundtable LLC from 2011 to 2015.
